rows.source_witness: Q_N2 from qbeta-ck-cache.witness.json (deepest DERIVED-tier rung). c_2 = -1 PROVED via qou:QOU.BraidKnot.q_beta_categorical_precision_ladder + Kashiwara N2_factor. Higher c_k are tier='cal-anchored' (extracted from CODATA Q_β, circular, q₀-dependent) — cached for downstream reuse but NOT credited as a prediction. See deep audit docs/audits/2026-05-30-qbeta-ck-mp-dk-deep-audit.md and qbeta-scaling-bridge-investigation.witness.json. 🟧 CONDITIONAL ON CONJECTURES, NOT A DERIVED PREDICTION (owner 2026-11-20, qou-99qc option B; and: rulings are temporary conjectures). Q_beta = |eps_n - eps_p|*E0 on the gamma-gamma base V^3 (same word for both nucleons, PR #8564), with eps the T^3 components of Tr(K^x3 .)/[2]^3 = the z_D Markov trace (PR #8586): eps_flavour(V^3) = -0.0769805346013, E0 = 4.2274833556 MeV (tower-summed, posited). The value holds IF conjectures C1 (decay functional = weight-trace difference), C2 (both elements V^3) and C3 (Q_beta = |eps|*E0) hold; QOU.QBeta.DecayConjectures.qbeta_eq_of_conjectures derives it from them (PR #8617). None of C1-C3 is proved. Calibrated: closed form vs explicit weight-space traces, gap 1.13195988485333904593863991136097397258531639976739227369783e-72. Zero c_k rungs (qou-cds1). Same value as the ruled-base cell (0.3254339287 MeV): the change is the label, not the number. The photon is the owner-ruled 1 + phi0 s0 + phi1 s1 + phi01 s0 s1^-1, and V^3 = gamma(0,0,qh) gamma(0,0,-q^-1 h) for both nucleons (photon_product_eq_borWord). The plain trace difference is 0 for EVERY photon pair, all six weights free (DecayConjectures.photonPair_trace_n_eq_p). The value here is the Cartan K-weighted term of the two-term Lagrangian trace (CategoricalLagrangianTwoTermBridge) only; its matter term, the quark-charge insertion Q_iQ_j, is NOT included (under the ruled all-pairs insertion its connected part is 0 on V^3 and a static -1/3 tr V^3 charge term remains). 🛑 SCOPE: a BASE with no ladder, OUTSIDE the ladder cap (F_required ~ 2.40 > 1, LadderFactorBound). The value was NOT blind (np-splitting audit 2026-11-15 §18/§21 already recorded 0.3254 MeV). UNSCORED HISTORY: nuc11_interleaved (0.6519 MeV), delta_S (0.4491 MeV); retired z = 1 laddered value 0.782334410278 MeV.

rows.note: CONDITIONAL on three unproved classes (ArchimedeanLimit, BlochSuslinUniqueness, BringZeroModeBlochClass) — a conditional prediction, not a proved derivation. The Schwinger factor is NOT FITTED and this is measured, not asserted: parametrising it as (1 - c*h^2*alpha), the c that hits CODATA exactly is 0.7312340272 and the 1-sigma window is [0.61846303, 0.84400502], so the published c = 1 lies OUTSIDE it, at 2.383 sigma -- a fitter would have taken 0.731. But it is NOT DERIVED either: the exact vertex-moment check (docs/audits/2026-07-14-alpha-em-phase3-schwinger-coefficient-exact-check.md) gives +0.1281 against the claimed -h^2 = -0.0437, wrong order and wrong sign, ratio -2.93, and recommends the tier 'structurally-motivated / empirically-anchored'. That is the honest label. Second-best scoreable row: 238x, against 970x (m_mu) and 152-177x (the Q_beta trio). NOTE the residual's SIGN depends on the CODATA edition (the 2018->2022 shift is 2.2x the residual); the reference is read from the registry so the edition is not a choice.

convention_frame_qbeta.cache_note: Convention C (z = sqrt(q)/(1+q)), reached only via --historical-convention-C. C was excised by owner ruling (2026-08-09, re-affirmed 2026-08-15 and 2026-08-26); this artifact is retained because 10 consumers read it, including the L2 dashboard per_observable_100x_status.py. The DEFAULT (convention D) path REFUSES: no D-frame ladder has been derived, so there is no D-frame c_k to emit (bean qou-cds1). Substituting z_D into alpha = (z-1)h/2 is proved invalid by QOU.QBeta.decayLadder_zC_threeRow_ne_zero and QOU.QBeta.eigenphase_bar_defect_of_fullBar.
convention_frame_qbeta.induced_error_unquantifiable_reason: qbeta_ck_cache.py raises SystemExit(2) under convention D ('convention D has no derived c_k ladder'), so no D-frame counterpart of this prediction exists to difference against.
convention_frame_qbeta.scored_rows_note: The Q_beta / m_n / Delta_pn rows published here are built at z_D = q^3/(q^2+1) -- the canonical convention -- on the base the owner ruled 2026-09-08, re-scored 2026-09-12. They do NOT consume this C cache, so this block records the cache's frame and is NOT a caveat on those rows. What IS open is that no c_k ladder exists on an admissible base (qou-cds1); see qbeta_ruled_base.ladder_on_admissible_base_exists.

functional_admissibility_qbeta.note: STRONGER THAN THE CONVENTION-FRAME NOTE, AND SEPARATE FROM IT. That note says the c_k LADDER is convention-C. This says the BASE the ladder sits on uses a functional convention D provably excludes: the published closed form solves to z = 1, which is not a root of the (1^3) weight numerator. The best ADMISSIBLE cell is +12.47% (the augmentation on Delta_S) against the published 0.16776%, and the RULED cell is -43.157% -- the ruled cell is the FARTHEST of the three from CODATA, which is the anti-fit directive working as designed, not a defect in the ruling. WHICH FUNCTIONAL TO ADOPT IS NO LONGER OPEN: the owner ruled 2026-09-08 that eps is the Markov trace at z_D = q^3/(q^2+1) (convention D, two-row truncation, D7), and authorised the dashboard re-score on 2026-09-12 with its price measured first (qbeta/qbeta-zd-rescore-price.witness.json). The Q_beta row is scored on the ruled base from that date, so this field records the admissibility EVIDENCE rather than a live defect -- it becomes the live warning again only if the re-score's calibration against this witness fails. Do NOT relate any cell to the ~1279 ppb the retired row used to show: that was post-ladder, and no ladder has been derived on an admissible base (qou-cds1, blocked on the phase qou-pdix), so what the ruled base would become with one is UNKNOWN. Applies to the m_n and Delta_pn rows, which are derived from this value -- and unlike the convention note, it is written ONTO those rows rather than cross-referenced from this one.
